programmes.d: Dr. G performs an autopsy on an alleged hit-and-run victim but finds no evidence of vehicular injury on the 41-year-old man's body. Could his alcoholism have had a role in his death?
A 94-year-old woman dies in the hospital after having a convulsion. The case becomes the business of the medical examiner's office when no one will sign her death certificate.
An infant and his two-year-old sister are found dead in a house shared by two families. At first, they are believed to have died from either carbon monoxide poisoning or cold medicine overdoses.
A decomposing body is found in a pond and a tent is found nearby. Dr. G performs the autopsy in the morgue but finds few clues other than fingerprints and mouthwash in the stomach.
Police patrolling the night streets hear gunshots and head to the scene. They find a nude middle-aged man in a parking lot lying face down in a puddle of blood.
The farmers go on their first solo dates and Jennifer Nettles leave the farmers a troubling letter.
The farmers and their ladies head to South Carolina for a college football game.
The four farmers head out on their second solo dates.
Ty hosts a roping event at his farm in Missouri. Jennifer encourages the farmers to up the romance.
The farmers are invited on a surprise date with a new potential love match.
The whole crew grows camping and each couple must reckon with their feelings.
A car packed with teenage girls crashes into a fence, and a pole shoots through the windshield into the driver.
A young boy is attacked by a shark and comes close to death as surgeons battle to save his life.
A man is bitten by a deadly rattlesnake, but because of religious reasons cannot receive a blood transfusion. Will he survive?
A young girl comes into the ER and can't move from the waist down. Her parents are angry as the doctors sent her home a week earlier.
Doctors perform a chest incision while awaiting surgeons; an iguana is brought in following a car accident.
A man goes into anaphylactic shock; a tough guy fears needles; a man stabs himself with a ninja sword; a patient believes she needs an exorcism.
A soldier comes into the ER with a stab wound, and a woman overdoses on diet pills.
A woman complains of stomach pains after eating toilet paper; an inmate has a 108-degree fever.
Doctors are baffled when a retired admiral is brought in and they don't understand what is making him grow weaker by the day.
Doctors must decide whether to put a hole in a teenager's head who has a serious head trauma to relieve pressure, or wait for more help.
When a bride on her way to her wedding suffers facial injuries in a car accident she's rushed to the ER.
A patient is brought into the ER after being shot in the thigh. Doctors can't find the bullet and are concerned when the patient gets chest pains.
While in the process of adopting a five-week-old baby, a mother takes him to work with her. While there, the baby inexplicably obtains a skull fracture while unsupervised.
On a Texas highway, a fire is discovered having burnt three bodies beyond recognition. Dr. G finds bullets in the bodies and determines that they were all shot before being set on fire.
An employee is found dead in a restaurant kitchen. Clues found near the body include an empty cash register, a knife, and a trail of blood splotches leading to a vandalized car in the parking lot.
A healthy 53-year-old woman is found dead in bed. After performing an autopsy and taking blood and tissue samples, Dr. G cannot find the cause of death.
A man is found dead in a motel room due to multiple shotgun wounds. Dr. G proves the scene isn’t what it seems.
